title: Unbounded ActiveJob enqueue from request
summary: Rails requests enqueue many jobs without bounds, deduplication, or idempotency.
rationale: Job fan-out can amplify background compute, retries, and queue latency.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Add idempotency, batching, deduplication, and backpressure.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
